description: Mint a short-lived upload token so the user can upload a browser-built index to their Tier 1 library. The token is valid 15 minutes for any number of sources under this principal and profile. The response includes the token AND the principal_id: hand the user BOTH to paste into the indexer page (token field + principal field) — the page never collects a principal_id on its own, and the library compares the token's principal to the upload body's principal_id. The token travels in the x-tier1-upload-token header. Authentication and an active paid plan are required. The user's keyed profile (derived locally, sent per request) is also required — only its fingerprint is bound into the token.

profile.description: The user's keyed profile, derived locally by the agent from the account key (profile_from_key_hex) and sent per request. Only its fingerprint travels onward — it is bound into the token, and the LIBRARY records it on first write.

name: index_upload_token

principal_id.description: The authenticated principal_id. Paste it into the indexer page's principal field alongside the token — the page never collects it on its own, and the LIBRARY compares it to the upload body's principal_id. A non-secret identifier, not a credential.

profile_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the profile, bound into the token and recorded by the LIBRARY on first write.

token.description: The upload token. Paste it into the indexer page's upload-token field; it travels in the x-tier1-upload-token header. Valid 15 minutes for any number of sources under this principal and profile.

title: Mint a Tier 1 browser-index upload token
